overview: This 203-page file traces Japanese naval vessels’ proposed visits to Philippine ports from 1931 to 1940. Embassy requests, State Department replies, and correspondence with War and Navy document approvals, customary courtesies, replenishment stops, itinerary changes, cancellations, and occasional delays or procedural confusion.
interest: The correspondence reveals how routine port diplomacy handled late notice, changing schedules, supply stops, and access to Cavite Naval Base.
